result.summary: Found several layout and content issues including duplicate listings, cut-off content at screen edge, and inconsistent card sizing.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poke' listings appear side by side in 'Fastest near you' section with same delivery time and price
issues.suggestion: Ensure unique restaurant data is fetched and displayed, or remove duplicate entry

issues.description: Third card 'Smash Bros Bu...' in 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll padding or card width so cards are not abruptly clipped at the viewport edge

issues.description: Category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right side, hiding additional categories
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue like a fade or partial next-item preview to indicate scrollability

issues.description: Generic/placeholder-looking icon illustrations used for Green Bowl Poke items instead of real food photography
issues.suggestion: Replace with actual restaurant/food images for better visual appeal and trust

issues.description: Pizza promo card at bottom is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding restaurant name and details
issues.suggestion: Ensure scrollable content area has proper padding to avoid being obscured by fixed bottom navigation
